```{python}
#| label: fig-gatpoly-sheet-schematic
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 1.5
#| fig-cap: "Two-terminal equivalent of the fixed strip. Its geometry and ports remain the same for all three sheet-resistance selections."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=14)
    elm.Resistor().at((0, 0)).to((5, 0)).label(r'$R_{AB}=R_{\square}L/W$')
    elm.Dot().at((0, 0)).label('A', loc='left')
    elm.Dot().at((5, 0)).label('B', loc='right')
```
